import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD_A = 998244353;
    static final int MOD_B = 1000000007;
    static final int BASE = 1000000;
    static List<Integer>[] sequences = new ArrayList[7];
    static int[] partialSum = new int[7];
    static long totalN;
    static long totalCount = 0;
    static long totalAnswer = 0;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            sequences[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generateSequences(int level, long prefix) {
        totalCount++;
        int val = (int)((totalCount - prefix + MOD_A) % MOD_A);
        sequences[level].add(val);
        partialSum[level] = (int)((partialSum[level] + val) % MOD_B);
        if (level == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            generateSequences(level + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static void processNumber(long x) {
        if (x > totalN) return;
        if (x * BASE + BASE - 1 <= totalN && x * BASE * 10 > totalN) {
            long currentCount = totalCount;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                int size = sequences[i].size();
                int diffVal = (int)(((currentCount - x * (long)Math.pow(10, i)) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A);
                int pos = lowerBound(sequences[i], MOD_A - diffVal);
                totalAnswer = (totalAnswer + (long)diffVal * size + partialSum[i]) % MOD_B;
                totalAnswer = (totalAnswer - (long)MOD_A * (size - pos) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B;
                totalCount += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        totalCount++;
        totalAnswer = (totalAnswer + ((totalCount - x) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A) % MOD_B;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            processNumber(x * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        totalN = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        generateSequences(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(sequences[i]);
        }
        totalCount = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            processNumber(i);
        }
        System.out.println(totalAnswer);
    }
}
